articles.summary: San Francisco, November 13, 2026 – AgileMD, Inc., an AI-powered clinical decision support company, announced today that it has entered into a definitive agreement to be acquired by Wolters Kluwer, a global leader in professional information solutions, software and services based in the Netherlands, and the provider of UpToDate. The transaction is subject to customary closing conditions and regulatory approvals.
articles.title: AgileMD to join Wolters Kluwer, bringing AI-powered clinical pathways and deterioration detection to clinicians worldwide
